# Which years should I bunch my charitable giving?

> Free charity bunching calculator: enter what you give each year and your deductions, and get the exact years to fund a donor-advised fund for the biggest tax saving, compared with giving directly and every-k-years cycles. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
